items.description: Pairs a label, description and error with a control, horizontally or vertically.
Horizontal or vertical bar for XP, health, loading and quest progress.
On/off toggle for settings; controlled or uncontrolled.
Press-and-hold confirmation with linear or radial progress, for risky actions.
Circular progress ring for cooldowns and timers; can hold content inside.
Label for a Field, with a required marker.
items.example: e(Ui.FieldLabel, { text = "Display name", required = true })

items.description: Stacks several Fields with consistent spacing, e.g. a settings page.
Helper text under a Field label.
items.example: e(Ui.FieldDescription, { text = "Shown to other players" })

items.description: Single or multi-line text input with placeholder, invalid and read-only states.
Themed panel that auto-sizes to its children and stacks them vertically.
Modal window with title, body, footer actions, backdrop and gamepad/Escape dismissal.
Checkbox with checked, indeterminate and invalid states; controlled or uncontrolled.
Single-choice group of RadioGroupItem options with keyboard and gamepad navigation.
Validation message for an invalid Field.
items.example: e(Ui.FieldError, { text = "Name is already taken" })

items.description: Clickable action with variants, sizes, icons, loading state and badges.
Themed label with display, heading, body, subtext and caption styles.
One option inside a RadioGroup.
items.example: e(Ui.RadioGroupItem, { value = "easy" })

items.description: Thin horizontal or vertical divider between groups.
items.example: e(Ui.Separator, { orientation = "horizontal" })

items.description: Groups a Field's label and description text.
items.example: e(Ui.FieldContent, nil, { Label = e(Ui.FieldLabel, { text = "Name" }) })
